title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Canonical Knowledge Distillation for Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: At matched compute and long schedules, plain logit / feature KD beats segmentation-specific KD; pure logit KD keeps scaling with unlabelled images while feature KD does not.
adaptation: Pure logit KD from the frozen 5-seed ensemble (full 24-class soft targets) over 478 labelled + 11.9k pool cells (incl. 1,152 half-cells), 60k-100k steps; keep the teacher architecture-aligned (U-Net++ family).
min_experiment: Arm: student on GT + pool KD, 60k steps, 3 seeds. Baseline: labelled-only KD student (Noothout arm) and house single. Metric: crack IoU, relF1@2, inactive IoU on CV / clean 49; E1 relF1@2 secondary. Kill: < +0.012 crack IoU over labelled-only KD and < +0.02 E1 relF1@2.
evidence: R: Cityscapes PSPNet-R18 student 79.0 vs R101 teacher 79.8 mIoU (feature KD, 55 GPU-h); pure logit KD + 20k unlabelled images also 79.0; Mask2Former teacher gave 77.8 vs 77.7 at 3x compute.
prior_overlap: partial: Mean Teacher with hard/tolerant pseudo-labels on the 11.9k pool at 100% labels was n.d.; that closes single EMA teachers with thresholded labels, not a frozen 5-seed ensemble with soft full-distribution targets and long schedules
